Each sea monster spell you cast has emerge. The emerge cost is equal to its mana cost. (You may cast those spells by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by the sacrificed creature's mana value. Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, Serpents, and Whales are sea monsters.)

Whenever a creature you control enters, if it was cast for its emerge cost, draw two cards, then discard a card.
